_comment:
Copper Peptide THREE-PRODUCT SET shots, 2026-09-10. Malcolm's brief: the Copper Peptide Serum together with the Day and Night creams, photographed as a set/bundle, for a selection. This is the 'bundle in a scene' brief that the BUNDLE-001 note in docs/todo.md explicitly parks as separate from the composited 3-up/6-up work: those are N units of ONE product and are composited so the label is identical by construction; this is THREE DIFFERENT products in one photograph, so it is generated and fans out to every supplier per BRAND-003.

THE ONE THING THIS BRIEF EXISTS TO PROTECT: the line shares one CARTON blue but three different CONTAINER blues - the serum is deep blue, the Day cream deep navy, the Night cream pale ice-blue. In a single-product shot an engine cannot conflate them. In a set shot it is the default failure: it picks one blue and paints all three. Every slot therefore states the three-way separation as its own instruction AFTER the per-product blocks, and the negative bars a shared blue explicitly.

WHY EACH LABEL IS QUOTED IN FULL: an unspecified label is an invented one - PDRN came back as PORN on this project. Three products in frame means three labels to garble, so all three are quoted verbatim with their ink colours, and the ink colours are marked as describing ink and never as words to print (BODY COPY and WHITE have both been set in type here before).

flux2 is skipped automatically by generate-multi.py whenever ref_files are present, so this run is 5 suppliers, not 6. Luma caps at 6000 characters and answers a longer prompt with a bare HTTP 422 that reads exactly like a content refusal, so every slot carries its own trimmed prompt_luma.

slots.prompt:
A premium skincare product photograph of THREE DIFFERENT Skingenetix Copper Peptide products standing together as one set on a single shared surface.

SHARED RULES FOR ALL THREE. Every metal part is NEUTRAL SILVER-GREY brushed satin aluminium with a fine grain, staying neutral next to the blue glass - never rose-gold, copper, champagne, brass or warm-tinted, and never a chrome mirror. Reproduce each front label exactly as in the supplied reference, every character verbatim. The Skingenetix wordmark is spelled with a capital S and the rest lower case, with no trademark, registered or copyright symbol anywhere. On each container a narrow vertical rule sits to the left of the text block. The ink colours given below describe the INK each line is printed in and are NEVER themselves printed as words - no colour name appears as text anywhere. Each container carries ONLY the lines listed for it: no benefit lines, no 'ALL SKIN TYPES', no ingredient list.

LEFT, a 50ml frosted DEEP NAVY BLUE glass cosmetic jar, wide and squat, about 1.15 times wider than its full height, with a deep brushed satin aluminium screw lid standing about a third of the jar's total height and roughly half the height of the glass body beneath it - a tall band, not a thin disc. Its glass is rich deep navy at the top fading downward to pale frosted white at the base. Its label lines, in this order: (1) the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark with the wordmark 'Skingenetix'; (2) 'COPPER PEPTIDE' in bold capitals on one line; (3) 'ADVANCED DAY REPAIR'; (4) 'PREMIUM FORMULA'; (5) a small sun glyph then 'DAY CREAM  |  2% GHK-CU  |  50ML'. Inks: the mark, the wordmark, line 2, line 4 and line 5 in white; line 3 and the vertical rule in light sky-blue.

CENTRE, standing taller than both jars, a 30ml frosted DEEP BLUE glass dropper bottle, straight-sided with square shoulders, fitted with a brushed satin aluminium collar and a white rubber-bulb pipette. Its glass is a rich deep blue at the top fading downward to pale frosted at the base. The white rubber bulb is an ELONGATED CAPSULE about 1.6 times taller than wide, standing about one third the height of the glass body; bulb plus collar together about two thirds of it - never short, squat, stubby or ball-shaped. Its label lines, in this order: (1) the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark with the wordmark 'Skingenetix'; (2) 'COPPER PEPTIDE' in bold capitals on one line; (3) 'ADVANCED' then 'REPAIR SERUM' on two lines; (4) 'PREMIUM FORMULA'; (5) '2% GHK-CU  |  30ML' in small capitals. Inks: the mark, the wordmark, line 2, line 4 and line 5 in white; line 3 and the vertical rule in light cornflower-blue.

RIGHT, a 50ml frosted PALE ICE-BLUE glass cosmetic jar of exactly the same shape and proportion as the left jar - about 1.15 times wider than its full height, same tall brushed satin aluminium lid. Its glass is a soft pale ice-blue, slightly deeper at the shoulders and lighter towards the base. Its label lines, in this order: (1) the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark with the wordmark 'Skingenetix'; (2) 'COPPER PEPTIDE' in bold capitals on one line; (3) 'ADVANCED NIGHT REPAIR'; (4) 'PREMIUM FORMULA'; (5) a small crescent-moon glyph then 'NIGHT CREAM  |  2% GHK-CU  |  50ML'. Inks: the mark, the wordmark, line 2, line 4 and line 5 in BLACK; line 3 and the vertical rule in strong royal-blue.

THE THREE BLUES ARE THREE DIFFERENT BLUES AND MUST READ AS THREE IN ONE FRAME. Left jar the darkest - a deep saturated navy. Centre bottle a rich mid deep-blue, clearly lighter than the left jar and clearly darker than the right. Right jar a soft pale ice-blue, the palest object of the three by a wide margin. Do not settle them into one shared blue and do not make any two of them match.

SCENE. A dark graphite surface and background, near-black, with a soft cool falloff behind. Cool directional key light from the upper left with a broad soft fill, so each container carries a clean vertical specular highlight down its edge and the brushed lids catch a soft band of light. Restrained cool reflections on the surface beneath. The palette is cool throughout - blues, steel greys, clean whites and pale ice tones.

FRAME. All three products stand fully inside the frame with clear dark margin above, below, left and right; nothing is cut by any edge. The three sit on one shared baseline, close enough to read as a set rather than three separate photographs, with the taller bottle at the centre. Square format. Sharp focus across all three front labels, every line legible.
